privilege.name: VinSHC: Read patient administration
privilege.description: Read VinSHC contact, field-state and address records.

privilege.name: VinSHC: Write patient administration
privilege.description: Create, update and void VinSHC contact, field-state and address records.

privilege.name: VinSHC: Record vitals
privilege.description: Record vital-sign observations through the validated VinSHC endpoint.

privilege.description: Create and discontinue validated outpatient drug orders.
